features.name: Strong Like Bear
features.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your stability.

abilities.name: Backhand
abilities.story_text: The bear casually swats the pesky foe into next week.
abilities.effect: The target takes damage equal to 4 + the bear's Might score and is pushed up to 2 squares.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: The target is force moved up to a number of additional squares equal to the bear's Might score.

advancement_features.name: Foe Thresher
advancement_features.description: Whenever the bear targets a creature with a strike that doesn't impose forced movement while rampaging, the bear can push the target up to a number of squares equal to the bear's Might score.

advancement_features.name: Ursine Form
advancement_features.description: While the bear is rampaging, you have damage immunity 5 and your size increases to the bear's size (to a maximum of 2). If you don't have enough unoccupied space to grow, you grow as soon as there is sufficient space.

advancement_features.name: Twin Colossi
advancement_features.description: While the bear is rampaging, you gain a +1 bonus to distance with melee weapon abilities, your size increases to match the bear's size (to a maximum of 3), and your strikes deal an extra 5 damage.

features.name: Stoned
features.description: A stoned creature is magically turning to stone. Each time a creature fails the saving throw to end this effect, they take corruption damage equal to the basilisk's Might score. A stoned creature or a creature adjacent to them can use a maneuver to cut the encroaching stone from the stoned target's body, ending the effect and dealing damage to the target equal to twice the basilisk's Might score that can't be reduced in any way. A creature reduced to 0 Stamina while they are stoned, or by an ability that causes a creature to become stoned, is turned to stone until they are restored to life by magical means.

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.story_text: Transfixed by the basilisk's magical gaze or struck by their poisoned claws, the foe's body begins to calcify.
abilities.effect: The target takes corruption damage equal to 3 + the basilisk's Might score and is stoned (save ends) (see Stoned ).
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: While stoned this way, the target is also slowed.

advancement_features.name: Foes Forever Frozen
advancement_features.description: Whenever the basilisk makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the target is stoned (save ends).

advancement_features.name: Rock Smasher
advancement_features.description: Whenever you deal rolled damage to a stoned creature while the basilisk is rampaging, you deal extra damage equal to twice your Might score.

advancement_features.name: Heart of Stone
advancement_features.description: While the basilisk is rampaging, you and the basilisk have damage immunity 10 as you become nearly impervious living statues.

features.name: Spiteful Endurance
features.description: While the boar is winded, they have damage immunity equal to their Might score and ignore the effects of bleeding.

abilities.name: Gore
abilities.story_text: With an enraged snort, the boar lunges forward to rip open foes with their tusks.
abilities.effect: The boar moves up to their speed in a straight line. When this movement ends, they can deal damage equal to 3 + their Might score to an adjacent target. If the boar moved closer to the target as part of this movement, the boar deals extra damage equal to their Might score.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: The target is bleeding until the end of their next turn.

advancement_features.name: Greased Pig
advancement_features.description: While the boar is rampaging, they have a +2 bonus to speed and a double edge on the Escape Grab maneuver.

advancement_features.name: Wild Rush
advancement_features.description: While the boar is rampaging, you can use their Gore maneuver, and you and the boar can shift instead of move when using the Charge action or the Gore maneuver.

advancement_features.name: Immortal Rage
advancement_features.description: Whenever you or the boar use an ability that deals damage while the boar is rampaging, you gain 10 temporary Stamina.

features.name: Moving Target
features.description: While the condor is flying and has a speed greater than 0, ranged strikes against them take a bane.

abilities.name: Flurry of Wings
abilities.story_text: I can't draw a bead on them with that infernal bird flapping in my face!
abilities.effect: The target takes damage equal to 3 + the condor's Might score. Additionally, enemies are weakened while adjacent to the condor until the end of your next turn.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: An enemy who would be weakened by this ability is taunted instead.

advancement_features.name: Dive Bomb
advancement_features.description: Whenever the condor makes a strike while rampaging, they deal extra damage equal to the number of squares they've moved on their turn (to a maximum of 5).

advancement_features.name: Borne Aloft
advancement_features.description: While the condor is rampaging, you gain wings and can fly. While flying, you gain a +2 bonus to speed. If you are midair when the condor's rampage ends, you take no damage from the fall.

advancement_features.name: Flight of the Condor
advancement_features.description: While the condor is rampaging, you and the condor gain a +5 bonus to speed.

features.name: Blood Frenzy
features.description: Whenever the deinonychus deals damage to a bleeding creature, they gain 1 surge.

abilities.name: Terrible Claws
abilities.story_text: The deinonychus kicks their prey, then slashes them with wicked claws.
abilities.effect: The target takes damage equal to 3 + the deinonychus's Might score, and if they have M < AVERAGE , they are bleeding until the end of their next turn.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: A target who has M < STRONG is bleeding (save ends).

advancement_features.name: Tear You to Ribbons
advancement_features.description: Whenever the deinonychus makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the target is bleeding until the end of their next turn.

advancement_features.name: Slake My Thirst in Blood
advancement_features.description: Whenever you use an ability that deals rolled damage to a bleeding creature while the deinonychus is rampaging, you gain 2 surges.

advancement_features.name: Reaping Scythe
advancement_features.description: The deinonychus's claws slash at creatures underfoot. When the deinonychus moves adjacent to an enemy or enters an enemy's space for the first time on a turn while rampaging, the deinonychus deals damage to that enemy equal to the deinonychus's Might score.

features.name: Elementally Attuned
features.description: When you gain this companion, you choose their attuned damage type from acid, cold, corruption, fire, lightning, poison, or sonic. The drake's attuned damage type affects their other features.

features.name: Shared Scales
features.description: You have immunity 3 to the drake's attuned damage type.

abilities.name: Drake Breath
abilities.story_text: The drake exhales a blast of flesh-melting energy.
abilities.effect: The target takes damage of the drake's attuned damage type (see Elementally Attuned ) equal to the drake's Might score.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 or 2 Ferocity: This ability affects a 3 cube (if you spend 1 ferocity) or a 4 cube (if you spend 2 ferocity) within 1.

advancement_features.name: Endless Breath
advancement_features.description: The drake's Drake Breath maneuver deals an extra 2 damage.

advancement_features.name: A Burning Inside Me
advancement_features.description: While the drake is rampaging, you gain draconic wings and can fly. If you are midair when the drake's rampage ends, you take no damage from the fall. Additionally, you can use the drake's Drake Breath maneuver until their rampage ends.

advancement_features.name: Elemental Avatar
advancement_features.description: While the drake is rampaging, you and the drake have immunity all to the drake's attuned damage type, and whenever you or the drake make a strike against a creature you can cause the target to be dragonsealed (save ends). A dragonsealed creature  has weakness 10 to the drake's attuned damage type.

features.name: Electric Surge
features.description: The first time on a turn that you or the spark deal lightning damage, you gain 1 surge.

abilities.name: Static Shock
abilities.story_text: An arc of lightning crackles from the spark.
abilities.effect: The target takes lightning damage equal to 2 + the spark's Might score.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: The distance increases to melee 5.

advancement_features.name: Electroshock
advancement_features.description: Whenever the spark makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, they can cause a target who has M < AVERAGE to be dazed until the end of the target's next turn.

advancement_features.name: Conductive
advancement_features.description: While the spark is rampaging, lightning sings through your blood, and whenever you make a strike against a creature, you deal extra lightning damage equal to your Might score.

advancement_features.name: Lightning Speed
advancement_features.description: While the spark is rampaging, you and the spark can shift up to your speed as a free maneuver once on each of your turns.

features.name: Gelatinous
features.description: The ball can occupy another creature's space. While occupying a creature's space, the ball has line of effect to that creature. If the creature completely fits within the ball's space, the creature has line of effect only to the ball and creatures outside the ball don't have line of effect to the creature. The ball's space is difficult terrain.

abilities.name: Absorb
abilities.story_text: With a sickening squelch, the ball oozes around their hapless prey.
abilities.effect: The target takes acid damage equal to 3 + the ball's Might score, and if they have A < AVERAGE , the ball moves into the target's space. If the target completely fits within the ball's space, the target is grabbed by the ball.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: A target grabbed this way takes acid damage equal to the ball's Might score at the end of each of the ball's turns.

advancement_features.name: Suck It Up
advancement_features.description: Whenever the ball makes a strike while rampaging, one target is pulled up to 3 squares into the ball's space. If the target ends this movement and completely fits within the ball's space, the target is grabbed by the ball.

advancement_features.name: Taffy Pull
advancement_features.description: While the ball is rampaging, your arms and legs become viscous and stretchy, and you gain a +2 bonus to speed and melee distance.

advancement_features.name: Runaway Expansion
advancement_features.description: While the ball is rampaging, you and the ball have acid immunity 10, and whenever a creature is reduced to 0 Stamina while inside the ball, the ball's size increases by 1 (to a maximum of 5). The ball's size can't increase this way more than once a turn, and the ball shrinks back to their original size when their rampage ends.

features.name: Hellish Pact
features.description: You have fire immunity equal to the hellhound's fire immunity.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.effect: The target takes fire damage equal to 3 + the hellhound's Might score.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: This ability gains a bonus to either its damage or distance equal to the hellhound's Intuition score.

advancement_features.name: Infernal Apparition
advancement_features.description: Whenever the hellhound makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, they can cause a target who has P < AVERAGE to be frightened until the end of the target's next turn.

advancement_features.name: Slavering Jaws
advancement_features.description: While the hellhound is rampaging, your mouth foams with acidic ichor, and whenever you make a strike against a creature, you deal extra acid damage equal to your Might score.

advancement_features.name: Wreathed in Flames
advancement_features.description: While the hellhound is rampaging, you and the hellhound are surrounded by an aura of flames, and each enemy who starts their turn adjacent to you or the hellhound takes fire damage equal to the hellhound's Might score.

features.name: Avoidance
features.description: Any effect on the lightbender that would be ended by a saving throw instead ends automatically at the end of their next turn.

abilities.name: Sparking Tail Whip
abilities.story_text: The lightbender swings their tail, sending gouts of sparks in their foe's face.
abilities.effect: The target takes damage equal to 3 + the lightbender's Might score, and if they have M < AVERAGE , they are dazzled until the end of their next turn. A dazzled creature has line of effect only within 1 square.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: A dazzled creature also takes a bane on strikes.

advancement_features.name: Hit and Run
advancement_features.description: Whenever the lightbender makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the lightbender can teleport up to 5 squares and use the Hide maneuver.

advancement_features.name: Lightbearer
advancement_features.description: While the lightbender is rampaging, you can use a free maneuver to glow with blinding light that lasts until the rampage ends or you use this ability again. While glowing, your skin sheds light for 10 squares and strikes against you take a bane.

advancement_features.name: Everywhere and Nowhere
advancement_features.description: While the lightbender is rampaging, your grip on spatial reality is weakened, and once on each of your turns, you or the lightbender can teleport up to 3 spaces as a free maneuver. Additionally, strikes made against you and the lightbender have a double bane until the lightbender's rampage ends.

features.name: Mighty Spring
features.description: Whenever the panther takes the Advance move action or the Charge action, they can jump up to a number of squares equal to their speed in any direction, including vertically, as part of this movement.

abilities.name: Pounce
abilities.story_text: The panther bunches up, then uncoils into a deadly leap.
abilities.effect: The target takes damage equal to 3 + the panther's Might score, and if they have M < AVERAGE , they are knocked prone.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: The panther can jump up to a number of squares equal to their speed before using this ability. If they jump at least 1 square in this way, a target who has M < STRONG is knocked prone.

advancement_features.name: Cat and Mouse
advancement_features.description: Whenever the panther makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the panther can knock the target prone.

advancement_features.name: Single Bound
advancement_features.description: While the panther is rampaging, you can jump up to a number of squares equal to your speed as a free maneuver once on each of your turns.

advancement_features.name: Panther Spirit
advancement_features.description: While the panther is rampaging, you and the panther are invisible and can move through objects and terrain, which are difficult terrain for you both. A creature who ends their turn inside a solid object from moving this way is teleported to the last unoccupied space they previously occupied.

features.name: Come Into My Parlor
features.description: Whenever the spider makes a strike against a restrained creature, the spider deals extra poison damage equal to twice their Intuition score.

abilities.name: Web Shot
abilities.story_text: The spider fires a ball of sticky silk. If the target has M < AVERAGE , they are restrained until the
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: If the target has M < STRONG , they are restrained (save ends).

advancement_features.name: Dripping Fangs
advancement_features.description: Whenever the spider makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the spider can deal extra poison damage equal to their Might score.

advancement_features.name: Web Slinger
advancement_features.description: Once on each of your turns while the spider is rampaging, you can shoot a web to a ceiling, wall, or sturdy object above you within 5 squares as a free maneuver. You can then fly in a straight line to any space within 5 squares of that object.

advancement_features.name: Life Drinker
advancement_features.description: Whenever you or the spider deals damage with a maneuver while the spider is rampaging, the attacker regains Stamina equal to the damage dealt.

features.name: Skulker
features.description: The sporeling can end their movement in an ally's space. While occupying an ally's space, the sporeling has cover.

abilities.name: Spore Puff
abilities.story_text: The sporeling breathes a cloud of disorienting fumes.
abilities.effect: The target takes poison damage equal to 3 + the sporeling's Might score, and the sporeling is invisible to the target until the end of the sporeling's next turn or they deal damage to the target.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: If the target has M < STRONG , they are dazed until the end of their next turn.

advancement_features.name: Slowing Spores
advancement_features.description: Whenever the sporeling makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, the sporeling can cause the target to be slowed until the end of the target's next turn.

advancement_features.name: Plant Walk
advancement_features.description: Once on each of your turns while the sporeling is rampaging, you can teleport to a space within 15 squares as a free maneuver, provided the space or an adjacent space contains the sporeling or plants or fungus of size 1S or larger. You then gain an edge on the next strike you make before the end of your turn.

advancement_features.name: Trailing Mycelia
advancement_features.description: While the sporeling is rampaging, you and the sporeling sprout rootlike, gripping mycelia along your limbs, and whenever you or the sporeling makes a strike against a creature who has M < STRONG, the creature is grabbed by the attacker. Additionally, you and the sporeling can't be force moved or knocked prone until the sporeling's rampage ends. ,

features.name: Retriever
features.description: The wolf can move at full speed while they have a creature grabbed, no matter the grabbed creature's size.

abilities.name: Clamping Jaws
abilities.story_text: With an unnerving growl, the wolf sinks powerful teeth into their quarry.
abilities.effect: The target takes damage equal to 3 + the wolf's Might score, and if they have M < AVERAGE , they are grabbed by the wolf.
abilities.special_effect: Spend 1 Ferocity: If the target has M < STRONG , they are grabbed by the wolf.

advancement_features.name: My, What Big Teeth You Have
advancement_features.description: Whenever the wolf makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, they can grab the target.

advancement_features.name: Call of the Wild
advancement_features.description: While the wolf is rampaging, you and the wolf gain a +2 bonus to speed, and creatures within 5 squares can't be hidden or have concealment from you or the wolf.

advancement_features.name: Dire Wolf
advancement_features.description: While the wolf is rampaging, you and the wolf are surrounded by an aura of dread, and enemies who start their turn adjacent to you or the wolf who have P < STRONG are frightened until the end of their next turn.
